notes.title: Battle bug fix 1.7.51
notes.notes:
We took a small break, but we are back. This is just a quick update to fix some errors caused by our engine updating.
Thanks for playing!

notes.title: SPRING CLEANING UPDATE GOING LIVE!
notes.notes:
As promised a week-or-so ago, [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/about]we're[/url] rolling out an update for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/864020/Lost_Legend]Lost Legend[/url]. We've been working a lot on adding more to the story. It's been a long time since we've pushed an update, but that's because there's been a lot of stuff we've done that the player couldn't access yet. Now, the main story should have a lot more progression. 

Some music files have been changed to sound better, and a soundtrack will hopefully be available on the 28th of March! Mark your calendar! 

Some grammatical issues have been fixed. Some game-breaking bugs have been fixed. 

As [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/adam]I[/url] said before, thank you for your continued support in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/864020/Lost_Legend]Lost Legend[/url] and in [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com]Unhinged LLC[/url]. We will post another update soon!

Thanks,

-  [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/adam]Adam[/url] and  [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/brandon]Brandon[/url]

notes.title: Spring Cleaning Update
notes.notes:
Although not everything is reachable by the player yet, [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/brandon]Brandon[/url] and [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/adam]I[/url] have been working hard to add content to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/864020/Lost_Legend/]Lost Legend[/url]. [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/ryan]Ryan Wiley[/url] has done some more voice acting, and our friend [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/elijah]Elijah[/url] has done some icon images. Despite having full-time jobs, we're trying to get this game finished.

You'll notice the library and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/864020/Lost_Legend/]store pages[/url] now have more up-to-date artwork. The screenshots we had on the store page were quite old, and the library image was a screenshot from a scene that had very little to do with the overall game. Now, more characters are represented, and Alchemy as a whole is now also represented. Also on the  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/864020/Lost_Legend/]store page[/url] you may notice that we [i]kindof[/i] have a release date posted. [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/brandon]Brandon[/url] and [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/adam]I[/url] hope to have the game finished by the end of 2022... or, at least hopefully the beginning of 2023. As [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/adam]I[/url] mentioned earlier, [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/brandon]Brandon[/url] and [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/adam]I[/url] work full-time jobs. We're each 25, we each just purchased a house, and we are each doing other things that people in their 20s do while starting their independent lives. We hope you guys understand. 

We thank you for continuing to support [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/864020/Lost_Legend/]Lost Legend[/url] and [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com]Unhinged LLC[/url], and we hope to post another update soon with an actual game build update to go along with it. 

Until then. 

- [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/adam]Adam[/url]

notes.title: 1.7.9 Small number decent sized changes
notes.notes:
-Added a new book menu to keep tack of all the lore around the world.
-Added in a new enemy you'll face during the story.
-Fixed 1,000,000 bugs.
-Added a bunch of new combat abilities and such (still being tuned).
-Added a way to finally leave the crucible and continue the story.

We have much much more planned and in the works and we can't wait till its ready to play!

Thank you to everyone who follows Lost Legend and we hope to see you tune in on our twitch streams or give us feedback in the forums or comments. We cannot wait to share the entire Lost Legend story with you!

notes.title: Alpha 1.7.7 2021 Easter Update.
notes.notes: Reworked a lot of things that are not currently available to the player, but we also made our intro cutscene considerably better as well as our intro island.

notes.title: Easter Update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We've just made an update to Lost Legend. A few things have changed:

[list]
[*] Kastburg is closer to completion. This city is proving to be very difficult for us to finish. For some reason, making progress on this city requires more motivation than other things on the game.
[*] Cephren Town has been updated. We've changed some graphics and made characters more lively. 
[*] The introduction has been scrapped and changed to one that better connects the player to our main character. 
[*] The option of a male protagonist, Kolton, is completely phased out once and for all: we've decided that our story's hero is female.
[*] A multitude of other small changes, like fixing spelling mistakes and such. 
[/list]

The game will remain [b]on sale until Sunday[/b] for those of you who still haven't purchased your copy. Thanks for everyone's support!

notes.title: Lost Legend has a Mac OSX version!
notes.notes: We have recently acquired a Macbook so we now able to develop a version of the game for it. We hope it will ease some players minds to know they can play on a Mac or PC. At the moment Steam Cloud support is busted but we are working on that so your save files will transfer between both.

notes.title: Important Update!
notes.notes: It has occurred to us that some of you may not be able to open the game. We are very sorry about this and we are putting out an update TODAY to fix this and add a few more features. We want your experience to be the very best with Lost Legend and we appreciate everyone that has already purchased the game. Thank you all and we hope to see some great feedback from the community.
